objective: For the cut-open torus walk at n = 2^m over GF(2), with q = 2n and K(a) = sum over x in GF(q) of (-1)^Tr(x + a/x) (1/0 = 0): (1) prove that sum over a in GF(q)* of K(a)(K(a) - 2)/8 = n(n - 1)/2, so that lower bounds ord_(mu = a) det(I - mu A_cone) >= K(a)(K(a) - 2)/8 at every a in GF(q)* would prove the collapse and the law together; (2) the target: the Kloosterman law, that the eigenvalue 1/a of A_cone has algebraic multiplicity K(a)(K(a) - 2)/8, geometric multiplicity |K(a)|/4 and Jordan blocks 1, 5, 9, ... (K(a) > 0) or 3, 7, 11, ... (K(a) < 0), hence the collapse at every power of two; or the gap stated. Found by exact computation before registration: the law's multiplicities at sides 4 to 128 and its geometric multiplicities at 4 to 64.
status: Proved 2026-11-09 (by hand, with finite checks; pre-registered in 76cc32e30): K(a) = 0 mod 4 and the Kloosterman multiplicities K(a)(K(a) - 2)/8 add up to n(n - 1)/2 over GF(2n)*, so lower bounds at every a would prove the collapse and the law; the eigenvectors at 1/a are the F of degree below h with (k + 1) F(k + 1) = Omega_b(k) F(k) mod k^h, b = sqrt(a); on GF(2n)* Omega_b(y) = y^h Tr(b^4/y) + b^2/y^h; the shift's curve is the Kloosterman curve Y^2 + Y = x + c^-4/x. Computed exactly: the Kloosterman law (algebraic multiplicity K(K - 2)/8, geometric |K|/4, Jordan blocks 1, 5, 9, ... or 3, 7, 11, ...) at every class for sides 4 to 128 and every eigenvector count to side 512; the law's period equals the computed one at 4 to 128; at sides 3 to 20 other than powers of two the eigenvalues are not in the field of (2n - 1)-th roots of unity. The target, the lower bounds and with them the collapse, is not proved.
title: Kloosterman multiplicities and the collapse
